categories.text:
Description: In 2025, the e-commerce category encompassing food, beverages, and cleaning items accounted for more than 6.16 trillion Argentine pesos, which makes it the second best-selling online segment after travel tickets and tourism. Argentina's e-commerce
sector generated a revenue of over 34 trillion pesos, including business-to-consumer (B2C) and customer-to-customer (C2C) sales in 2025. Read more
Note(s): 2021 to 2025; 204 e-commerce providers**; B2C only; includes VAT; * Excluding sports apparel. ** Number of respondents in 2025. The original question posed on the survey was: "Regarding the product categories you offer online, please [...] Read more
Source(s): CACE

forecast_users.text:
Description: The revenue in the e-commerce market in Argentina was modeled to be 17.24 billion U.S. dollars in 2024. Between 2017 and 2024, the revenue rose by 12.08 billion U.S. dollars, though the increase followed an uneven trajectory rather than a consistent
upward trend. The revenue will steadily rise by 11.39 billion U.S. dollars over the period from 2024 to 2029, reflecting a clear upward trend. Read more
Note(s): Argentina; 2017 to 2029; estimates
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

Description: In 2024, the online sales revenue in Argentina amounted to more than 22 trillion Argentine pesos. This represents an increase of more than 180 percent in e-commerce revenue regarding year 2023. In 2024, Argentina's inflation rate was forecast to
surpass 220 percent. Read more
Note(s): 2014 to 2024; 197 e-commerce providers*; B2C and C2C
